description: The plot titled “ChatGPT on Songs” illustrates how three measured values vary with answer popularity, showing multiple line series on the same axes. The x-axis is labeled “Answer Popularity,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 10 to 160 with numeric ticks shown at regular 20-unit intervals (20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 160). The y-axis is labeled “Values,” uses a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, with evenly spaced tick labels at 0.2 intervals. One series is a blue solid line with circular markers labeled “Accuracy,” which starts near 0.55 at popularity 10, dips to about 0.48 at 20, rises to about 0.76 at 40 and about 0.82 at 50–60, is around 0.80 at 75, peaks near 0.88 at 95, and then sits around 0.83–0.84 from 120 through 155. A second series is a green solid line with upward triangle markers labeled “Confidence,” which stays high throughout, starting around 0.92 at 10, near 0.90–0.91 at 20–30, rising to about 0.95–0.96 at 40–60, reaching about 0.97–0.98 around 75–95, and remaining around 0.96–0.97 from 120 to 155. The third series is a red solid line with square markers (its legend label is obscured), beginning around 0.63 at 10, dropping to about 0.58 at 20, increasing to about 0.81 at 40 and about 0.85 at 50–60, dipping to about 0.83 at 75, peaking near 0.90 at 95, and then staying around 0.86–0.87 from 120 to 155.
